july_faithfulness.is_not: a reproduction of the July run; no number here is comparable to a July number as if it were the same experiment
july_faithfulness.operational_lineage: the August V26 J2 parent and the current J7 dataset, 16713 rows

controller_columns_bit_zero.why: the inverse-scale absorption is only valid on a parent whose scaled columns start at exactly zero

raw_vs_scaled_equivalence.justifies: absorbing the scale into pi.0.0.weight at save time: at initialisation the raw-input and scaled-input representations of the parent coincide exactly, so the absorption changes no behaviour it should not

determinism.replicated: July's DOCUMENTED seeding protocol and its Generator / split / shuffle order
determinism.not_replicated: the deterministic-algorithms backend and the thread count: never recorded for the July run, absent from the snapshot closest to it, so not forced and not claimed

torch_backend_observed.why_not_forced: the July run recorded neither setting and the code snapshot closest to it contains neither call; forcing them would be an invention, not a replication
torch_backend_observed.observed_at: fit time; the preflight is torch-free and cannot observe them

numpy_legacy_global_seed.position: after torch.manual_seed, before the Generator, as in July's adapt_actor
numpy_legacy_global_seed.note: July's legacy global seed, carried for protocol fidelity; it is not a second Generator

generators.note: the ONLY Generator; the legacy global seed is not one

split.ordering: initial permutation first; validation membership sorted; training order preserved; the SAME Generator then produces the epoch shuffles
split.indices_are_in_execution_order: train_indices below are recorded in the order the fit consumed them, NOT sorted

nominal_rmse.note: the nominal labels ARE the parent's own means, so 'before' is ~0 by construction and only the numpy/torch kernel difference separates it from exactly 0. This is a diagnostic, never a gate.

diagnostics_nonbinding.no_closed_loop_claim: nothing here was evaluated in closed loop

output.write_protocol: atomic commit, no-clobber under exclusive fit lock

lock.does_not_guarantee: nothing is claimed against a writer that ignores the lock; os.rename on POSIX silently replaces an existing EMPTY directory
lock.if_it_pre_exists: fail closed, removing no lock this run does not own

cleanup_scope.staging: recursive removal of the exact staging directory this run created
cleanup_scope.lock: unlinked only if this run created it
cleanup_scope.parent: non-recursive rmdir, only if this run created it and only if empty
cleanup_scope.never: no recursive removal of j8_runs; concurrent content survives

outcome.note: an offline fit qualifies nothing. Only a fresh deterministic closed-loop revalidation could speak to behaviour, and this stage runs none.

deferred_todo.loto: NOT integrated. Leave-one-trial-out remains a future TODO.
deferred_todo.loco: NOT integrated. Leave-one-condition-out remains a future TODO.
deferred_todo.multistart_training_data: DEFERRED. The two July teacher datasets at start offsets -0.20 and +0.20 rad, 8000 rows, are not reproduced and are not part of this dataset.
deferred_todo.multistart_closed_loop_validation: A DIFFERENT AND UNRELATED THING, also future. Deferring the multistart TRAINING DATA says nothing about the future multistart CLOSED-LOOP validation, and the two must never be conflated.
